story_type: giant cargo jet lands and takes off on a dirt runway
hook: This giant Air Force jet is landing on dirt.
narration: This giant Air Force jet is landing on dirt.
It's a C-17 Globemaster Three from Joint Base Lewis-McChord, coming in to Schoonover Army Airfield at Fort Hunter Liggett, California.
Schoonover is one of only a few dirt airfields in the country where Air Force and Marine pilots can keep their dirt landing certifications.
Pilots train for it because a battlefield or a disaster zone may not have a paved runway.
A ground crew inspects the strip after every turnaround and keeps the pilots updated on the wind.
[short pause] And every landing throws up a wall of dust.
outcome: Then the C-17 roared back down the dirt strip and took off again.
title: C-17 lands in a wall of dust
description:
A C-17 Globemaster III from Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington, lands and takes off from the dirt runway at Schoonover Army Airfield, Fort Hunter Liggett, California, on March 18, 2019.

Footage: U.S. Army video by Cynthia McIntyre, Fort Hunter Liggett Public Affairs Office, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/667723/mcchord-c-17-fort-hunter-liggett
